ibis-sqlite's native LOWER()/UPPER() are ASCII-only (no ICU extension loaded); CASE_INSENSITIVE's Unicode-aware-lowercasing contract (e.g. Kelvin Sign U+212A -> 'k') is unavailable on this dialect alone in the Ibis family — gated unconditionally for every ibis-sqlite connection and every input (including purely-ASCII input, which SQLite's native LOWER() handles correctly, and any caller-supplied connection with a custom Unicode-aware LOWER()/UPPER() override loaded onto it) because the capability fact is keyed on (backend, dialect), a static identity, with no visibility into a specific connection's actual loaded extensions or a specific call's runtime string content
constraints.workaround: Use CASE_INSENSITIVE_ASCII instead if ASCII-only folding is sufficient (genuinely honored on ibis-sqlite via native translate()); otherwise Unicode-normalize both operands in Python (e.g. str.lower()) and reissue the comparison as CASE_SENSITIVE (NOT CASE_INSENSITIVE — this dialect-scoped gate is unconditional and still rejects CASE_INSENSITIVE even after preprocessing), or run this expression against a different Ibis dialect (ibis-duckdb) instead of ibis-sqlite

ibis-sqlite's native LOWER()/UPPER() are ASCII-only (no ICU extension loaded); CASE_INSENSITIVE's Unicode-aware-lowercasing contract (e.g. Kelvin Sign U+212A -> 'k') is unavailable on this dialect alone in the Ibis family — gated unconditionally for every ibis-sqlite connection and every input (including purely-ASCII input, which SQLite's native LOWER() handles correctly, and any caller-supplied connection with a custom Unicode-aware LOWER()/UPPER() override loaded onto it) because the capability fact is keyed on (backend, dialect), a static identity, with no visibility into a specific connection's actual loaded extensions or a specific call's runtime string content
constraints.workaround: Use CASE_INSENSITIVE_ASCII instead if ASCII-only folding is sufficient (genuinely honored on ibis-sqlite via native translate()); otherwise Unicode-normalize both operands in Python (e.g. str.lower()) and reissue the comparison as CASE_SENSITIVE (NOT CASE_INSENSITIVE — this dialect-scoped gate is unconditional and still rejects CASE_INSENSITIVE even after preprocessing), or run this expression against a different Ibis dialect (ibis-duckdb) instead of ibis-sqlite

constraints.message: ibis-polars has no compilation rule for StringTranslate (OperationNotDefinedError); the ASCII-only fold CASE_INSENSITIVE_ASCII needs for contains/starts_with/ends_with is unavailable on this dialect, unlike ibis-duckdb/ibis-sqlite which both support .translate()

ibis-sqlite's native LOWER()/UPPER() are ASCII-only (no ICU extension loaded); CASE_INSENSITIVE's Unicode-aware-lowercasing contract (e.g. Kelvin Sign U+212A -> 'k') is unavailable on this dialect alone in the Ibis family — gated unconditionally for every ibis-sqlite connection and every input (including purely-ASCII input, which SQLite's native LOWER() handles correctly, and any caller-supplied connection with a custom Unicode-aware LOWER()/UPPER() override loaded onto it) because the capability fact is keyed on (backend, dialect), a static identity, with no visibility into a specific connection's actual loaded extensions or a specific call's runtime string content
constraints.workaround: Use CASE_INSENSITIVE_ASCII instead if ASCII-only folding is sufficient (genuinely honored on ibis-sqlite via native translate()); otherwise Unicode-normalize both operands in Python (e.g. str.lower()) and reissue the comparison as CASE_SENSITIVE (NOT CASE_INSENSITIVE — this dialect-scoped gate is unconditional and still rejects CASE_INSENSITIVE even after preprocessing), or run this expression against a different Ibis dialect (ibis-duckdb) instead of ibis-sqlite

facts.message: ibis-sqlite's native LOWER()/UPPER() are ASCII-only (no ICU extension loaded); CASE_INSENSITIVE's Unicode-aware-lowercasing contract (e.g. Kelvin Sign U+212A -> 'k') is unavailable on this dialect alone in the Ibis family — gated unconditionally for every ibis-sqlite connection and every input (including purely-ASCII input, which SQLite's native LOWER() handles correctly, and any caller-supplied connection with a custom Unicode-aware LOWER()/UPPER() override loaded onto it) because the capability fact is keyed on (backend, dialect), a static identity, with no visibility into a specific connection's actual loaded extensions or a specific call's runtime string content
facts.workaround: Use CASE_INSENSITIVE_ASCII instead if ASCII-only folding is sufficient (genuinely honored on ibis-sqlite via native translate()); otherwise Unicode-normalize both operands in Python (e.g. str.lower()) and reissue the comparison as CASE_SENSITIVE (NOT CASE_INSENSITIVE — this dialect-scoped gate is unconditional and still rejects CASE_INSENSITIVE even after preprocessing), or run this expression against a different Ibis dialect (ibis-duckdb) instead of ibis-sqlite

payload.condition: resource.dialect.comment_char is set or resource.dialect.comment_rows is set or resource.dialect.double_quote is set or resource.dialect.escape_char is set or resource.dialect.header_join is set or resource.dialect.header_rows is set or resource.dialect.line_terminator is set or resource.dialect.skip_initial_space is set
payload.probe_exempt: router, not gate — fallback handles it; behaviour covered by relations resource tests

divergences.summary: Ibis names un-aliased aggregate measures "Sum(v)" rather than source column "v"
divergences.impact: Inferred schemas and Ibis runtime output names can disagree
divergences.workaround: Always alias aggregate measures when pipelines may execute on Ibis

divergences.summary: ibis-polars product() returns None instead of the product (no wired product aggregate on the ibis-polars path)
divergences.impact: product() returns None on ibis-polars; polars/narwhals and ibis-duckdb/ibis-sqlite compute it (ibis-duckdb overflows only on a zero factor)
divergences.workaround: Use a polars or narwhals backend for product aggregates

divergences.summary: ibis-polars/ibis-sqlite infer an untyped NullColumn for an all-null input, which has no aggregate method (AttributeError: NullColumn has no 'sum'/'mean'/'std'/'var'/'nunique')
divergences.impact: sum/mean/std_dev/variance/n_unique/any_value over an all-null column raise AttributeError on ibis-polars/ibis-sqlite; ibis-duckdb rejects the table outright (IB-REL-06), polars/narwhals compute None
divergences.workaround: Cast the all-null column to an explicit type first, or use a polars/narwhals backend

divergences.summary: product() with a zero factor breaks the log-based product implementation on ibis SQL: ibis-duckdb raises OutOfRangeException, ibis-sqlite returns a wrong value
divergences.impact: product() over data containing 0 fails on ibis-duckdb (OutOfRangeException) and diverges on ibis-sqlite; polars/narwhals compute 0 (ibis-polars returns None — IB-AGG-05)
divergences.workaround: Use a polars or narwhals backend for product() over data that may contain zero

divergences.summary: DuckDB uses IEEE 754 banker's rounding (half-to-even) casting float to integer
divergences.impact: Tests expecting truncation-on-cast produce different results on ibis-duckdb
divergences.workaround: Explicit floor()/ceil() before cast, or use ibis-sqlite/polars

divergences.summary: SQLite CAST is lenient, parsing CAST('1x' AS INTEGER) as 1
divergences.impact: Strict casts do not raise for malformed input on ibis-sqlite
divergences.workaround: Validate malformed input via conform/typespec or use another Ibis backend

divergences.summary: ibis-sqlite has no SQL compilation rule for TryCast (cast failure_behavior=NULL); the op raises OperationNotDefinedError
divergences.impact: ma.col(x).cast(dtype, failure_behavior=NULL) raises on ibis-sqlite; ibis-polars/ibis-duckdb and polars null the invalid rows
divergences.workaround: Use a polars or ibis-polars/ibis-duckdb backend for null-on-cast-failure semantics

divergences.summary: ibis-sqlite has no SQL compilation rule for is_finite/is_infinite; the ops raise OperationNotDefinedError
divergences.impact: ma.col(x).is_finite()/is_infinite() raise on ibis-sqlite; polars, pandas, narwhals, and ibis-polars/ibis-duckdb evaluate them
divergences.workaround: Use is_null/fill checks or a non-sqlite backend for infinity detection

divergences.summary: Ibis strips RECURSIVE from generated CTE SQL, turning WITH RECURSIVE into WITH
divergences.impact: Recursive CTE SQL cannot be generated through Ibis

divergences.summary: DuckDB ^ is bitwise on integers, not logical XOR on booleans
divergences.impact: Chained boolean parity via xor diverges on ibis-duckdb
divergences.workaround: polars, narwhals, or ibis-sqlite for boolean parity

divergences.summary: now() returns naive UTC query-time timestamps on ibis-duckdb and ibis-sqlite
divergences.impact: On non-UTC hosts, now() differs from the local naive datetime snapshot used by Polars, Narwhals and ibis-polars
divergences.workaround: Account for UTC query-time semantics, or use Polars, Narwhals or ibis-polars for local datetime snapshots

divergences.summary: ibis-polars rejects calendar-based interval arithmetic (add_years/add_months/offset by months/years) with a TypeError; only duration-based intervals (days/hours/…) work
divergences.impact: dt.add_years()/add_months() and month/year offsets raise TypeError on ibis-polars; ibis-duckdb/ibis-sqlite and polars/narwhals compute them
divergences.workaround: Use a polars/narwhals backend or ibis-duckdb/ibis-sqlite for calendar-interval arithmetic

divergences.summary: ibis-polars/ibis-sqlite have no TimestampDelta translation for time-unit differences (diff_days/diff_hours/diff_minutes) — OperationNotDefinedError
divergences.impact: dt.diff_days()/diff_hours()/diff_minutes() raise on ibis-polars and ibis-sqlite; ibis-duckdb and polars/narwhals compute them
divergences.workaround: Use ibis-duckdb or a polars/narwhals backend for time-unit differences

divergences.summary: ibis-sqlite cannot truncate timestamps to sub-day units (hour) — UnsupportedOperationError
divergences.impact: dt.truncate() to hour (and chains ending in a sub-day truncate) raise on ibis-sqlite; other backends compute them
divergences.workaround: Use a polars/narwhals backend or ibis-duckdb for sub-day truncation

divergences.summary: ibis-sqlite stores datetimes as strings, so sub-day arithmetic and comparisons produce wrong values (negative-hour offsets, month subtraction, within/between-time filters)
divergences.impact: sub-day temporal arithmetic/comparison on ibis-sqlite silently diverges (wrong values, not a raise); other backends compute them correctly
divergences.workaround: Use a polars/narwhals backend or ibis-duckdb for sub-day datetime arithmetic and comparisons

divergences.summary: SQLite < 3.46 lacks time-shift modifiers, so calendar arithmetic (add_days/add_months/month_end/days_in_month/combined offsets) is unavailable on ibis-sqlite; SQLite >= 3.46 supports them (environment-conditional — the mark is applied only below 3.46)
divergences.impact: calendar/offset arithmetic raises on ibis-sqlite when the linked SQLite is < 3.46; >= 3.46 computes them
divergences.workaround: Upgrade SQLite to >= 3.46, or use another backend for calendar arithmetic

divergences.summary: ibis-sqlite microsecond extraction returns whole seconds instead of the microsecond component
divergences.impact: dt.microsecond() returns the wrong value on ibis-sqlite; other backends return the microsecond component
divergences.workaround: Use a polars/narwhals backend or ibis-duckdb for microsecond extraction

divergences.summary: Ibis nanosecond extraction returns 0 — no sub-microsecond precision is retained from Python datetime inputs on any ibis backend
divergences.impact: dt.nanosecond() returns 0 on ibis-duckdb/ibis-polars/ibis-sqlite; polars/narwhals retain nanosecond precision
divergences.workaround: Use a polars/narwhals backend for nanosecond precision

divergences.summary: ibis-sqlite dt.time() returns a timedelta instead of a time value
divergences.impact: dt.time() yields the wrong type on ibis-sqlite; other backends return a time
divergences.workaround: Use a polars/narwhals backend or ibis-duckdb for dt.time()

divergences.summary: ibis-polars cannot compile month_end()/days_in_month(): the interval construction passes months= to duration(), raising TypeError (duration() got an unexpected keyword argument 'months')
divergences.impact: ma.col(x).dt.month_end()/days_in_month() raise TypeError on ibis-polars; ibis-duckdb/ibis-sqlite and polars compute them
divergences.workaround: Use ibis-duckdb/ibis-sqlite or a polars backend for month_end/days_in_month

divergences.summary: Ibis lacks native array operations for these list ops; the mountainash ibis expression system raises BackendCapabilityError (unenriched)
divergences.impact: list.gather_every/arg_min/arg_max/n_unique/count_matches/drop_nulls/set_difference/std/var/shift/diff/reverse/slice/head/tail/median raise on ibis backends
divergences.workaround: Use a Polars backend for these list operations

divergences.summary: SQLite lacks hyperbolic math functions
divergences.impact: sinh/cosh/tanh/asinh/acosh/atanh unavailable on ibis-sqlite
divergences.workaround: Any backend other than ibis-sqlite

divergences.summary: SQLite performs integer division for two integer operands
divergences.impact: Division expecting float results silently truncates on ibis-sqlite
divergences.workaround: Cast one operand to float before dividing

divergences.summary: SQL modulo takes the sign of the dividend rather than the divisor
divergences.impact: Cyclic calculations and hash bucketing with negative dividends diverge
divergences.workaround: Ensure the dividend is non-negative or normalize with a conditional expression

divergences.summary: ibis-polars and ibis-duckdb lack hyperbolic math functions in the mountainash arithmetic system; these ops raise NotImplementedError (ibis-sqlite is a separate engine limitation, IB-MATH-02)
divergences.impact: sinh/cosh/tanh/asinh/acosh/atanh raise on ibis-polars and ibis-duckdb; polars computes them
divergences.workaround: Use a polars backend for hyperbolic functions

divergences.summary: DuckDB rejects tables containing untyped all-NULL columns
divergences.impact: Projections whose column is entirely null raise a type resolution error
divergences.workaround: cast the null column to an explicit type first

divergences.summary: ibis-sqlite lacks array/pivot relational translations: drop_nans, unpivot/melt raise OperationNotDefinedError
divergences.impact: Relation.drop_nans()/unpivot()/melt() raise on ibis-sqlite; other backends compute them
divergences.workaround: Use ibis-duckdb or a polars/narwhals backend for these relational ops

divergences.summary: cross_join between two same-named tables from different Ibis connections raises a column-binding error on ibis SQL backends (ibis-duckdb BinderException, ibis-sqlite OperationalError)
divergences.impact: Relation.cross_join() raises on ibis-duckdb/ibis-sqlite; polars/narwhals and ibis-polars compute it
divergences.workaround: Use a polars/narwhals backend or ibis-polars for cross joins

divergences.summary: ibis-sqlite has no TimestampDelta translation (OperationNotDefinedError, probe-confirmed on ibis 12.0.0); the asof emulation cannot compute a temporal distance there
divergences.impact: Relation.join_asof(strategy='nearest') or tolerance=... over a temporal `on` column raises BackendCapabilityError on ibis-sqlite; forward/backward over temporal keys (no distance needed) work fine there
divergences.workaround: Use ibis-duckdb, polars, or narwhals for temporal nearest/tolerance asof joins

divergences.summary: ibis-polars rejects the emulation's non-equality candidate join (TypeError: Only equality join predicates supported with pandas, probe-confirmed); forward/nearest strategies are permanently capability-gated there
divergences.impact: Relation.join_asof(strategy='forward'|'nearest') raises BackendCapabilityError on ibis-polars; backward is native and unaffected
divergences.workaround: Use ibis-duckdb, ibis-sqlite, polars, or narwhals for forward/nearest asof joins

divergences.summary: Ibis's SQL-backend asof paths (native duckdb backward, and the emulation used for forward/nearest and all sqlite strategies) order output by [by, on] for determinism, which groups rows contiguously by `by` value; Polars (and narwhals/pandas natively, and ibis-polars natively) instead preserve the left input's own row order, which differs whenever `by` groups are interleaved in that input
divergences.impact: Relation.join_asof(by=...) on ibis-duckdb/ibis-sqlite returns rows grouped by `by` value rather than in left input order when groups interleave; matched values are always correct, only row position differs
divergences.workaround: Use ibis-polars, polars, or narwhals if exact left-input row order must be preserved for interleaved by-groups

divergences.summary: DuckDB does not guarantee physical row order for a filtered scan; some OR-of-AND boolean predicates compile to a query plan that reorders matching rows relative to the left input, even though polars/narwhals/ibis-polars/ibis-sqlite all preserve input row order through filter
divergences.impact: Relation.filter() with certain compound boolean predicates may return rows in a different order than the input on ibis-duckdb; matched VALUES are always correct, only row position differs
divergences.workaround: Use polars, narwhals, ibis-polars, or ibis-sqlite if exact input row order must be preserved through filter, or add an explicit .sort() after filter

divergences.summary: ibis-polars rejects case-insensitive string matching (contains/starts_with/ends_with with case_sensitive=False) — UnsupportedArgumentError
divergences.impact: case-insensitive contains/starts_with/ends_with raise on ibis-polars; other backends compute them
divergences.workaround: Use ibis-duckdb/ibis-sqlite or a polars/narwhals backend for case-insensitive matching

divergences.summary: SQL engines treat NaN as NULL; NaN == NaN yields NULL not False
divergences.impact: is_nan/fill_nan/NaN comparisons diverge on SQL engines
divergences.workaround: Use is_null/fill_null on SQL backends

divergences.summary: Ibis defers type resolution to its backend, unlike eager Polars
divergences.impact: Type-sensitive operations and result comparisons can differ despite matching values

divergences.summary: ibis-polars has no translation rule for any WindowFunction (OperationNotDefinedError): rank/dense_rank/row_number/lead/lag/shift/first_value/last_value/nth_value/ntile/percent_rank/cume_dist/cumulative/diff/is_duplicated
divergences.impact: all window ops raise on ibis-polars; ibis-duckdb/ibis-sqlite and polars/narwhals handle them (rank family with 0-based divergence on ibis SQL — see IB-WIN-02)
divergences.workaround: Use ibis-duckdb/ibis-sqlite or a polars/narwhals backend

divergences.summary: ibis-duckdb/ibis-sqlite compute rank/dense_rank/row_number as 0-based, while polars/narwhals are 1-based
divergences.impact: rank()/dense_rank()/row_number().over() return values one lower on ibis-duckdb/ibis-sqlite; ordering-relative assertions still hold but absolute ranks differ
divergences.workaround: Add 1 to the result on ibis SQL backends, or use polars/narwhals for 1-based ranks

divergences.summary: Ibis lacks cum_prod as a window function (AttributeError at materialize)
divergences.impact: col().cum_prod() raises on all ibis backends; polars and eager narwhals compute it
divergences.workaround: Use a polars or eager narwhals backend for cumulative product

divergences.summary: Ibis raises BackendCapabilityError (unenriched) for rank(method='average'|'max') — no SQL equivalent
divergences.impact: rank(method='average') and rank(method='max') raise on all ibis backends; polars/narwhals compute them
divergences.workaround: Use rank(method='min'/'dense'/'ordinal') on ibis, or polars/narwhals for average/max

divergences.summary: corr() Substrait signature is wired only on ibis-polars; every other backend raises (NotImplementedError / UnsupportedOperationError / OperationNotDefinedError)
divergences.impact: ma.corr() raises on all backends except ibis-polars
divergences.workaround: Use ibis-polars for corr(), or compute correlation manually

divergences.summary: Conform preserves category values as their base scalar dtype.
divergences.impact: Native category encoding and categoriesOrdered sort metadata are not materialized. Unit D validates and reports the declaration.
divergences.workaround: Use Unit D category validation for membership and ordering metadata.

divergences.summary: conform struct dotted-source extraction is unsupported on pandas/narwhals-pandas (TypeError) and ibis-sqlite (UnsupportedBackendType) — no native struct column type
divergences.impact: conform() with a dotted struct source path raises on pandas/narwhals-pandas/ibis-sqlite; polars and ibis-duckdb/ibis-polars extract it
divergences.workaround: Use a polars backend or ibis-duckdb/ibis-polars for struct dotted-source conform

divergences.summary: conform discard-value/discard-row drift policies are unsupported on pandas/narwhals (unenriched BackendCapabilityError) and ibis-sqlite (OperationNotDefinedError)
divergences.impact: conform() discard_value/discard_row policies raise on pandas/narwhals and ibis-sqlite; polars and ibis-duckdb/ibis-polars apply them
divergences.workaround: Use a polars backend or ibis-duckdb/ibis-polars for discard drift policies

divergences.summary: conform multi-transform full pipeline raises IbisTypeError on all ibis backends (deferred type resolution rejects the chained transform)
divergences.impact: a full conform multi-transform pipeline raises on ibis-duckdb/ibis-polars/ibis-sqlite; polars/narwhals run it
divergences.workaround: Use a polars or narwhals backend for full conform transform pipelines

divergences.summary: ibis-sqlite cannot construct a native struct-typed table
divergences.impact: conform() with a native OBJECT source raises UnsupportedBackendType on ibis-sqlite; other supported native structured backends execute it
divergences.workaround: Use a non-SQLite Ibis backend or a Polars-backed backend for native struct conform

divergences.summary: Polars Object dtype has no defined Arrow representation; Narwhals' to_arrow() serializes raw object pointers instead of the underlying value
divergences.impact: an opaque-carrier structured field (no schema evidence, already-native Python container) fails to decode through logical egress when the source is a Narwhals-wrapped Polars frame
divergences.workaround: Use a bare Polars relation (not Narwhals-wrapped) or a pandas/narwhals-pandas source for an opaque structured field; a JSON-text or schema-proven native LIST/STRUCT carrier is unaffected

divergences.summary: Intermediate float precision and rounding differ across backends
divergences.impact: Exact equality comparisons on float results can fail across backends
divergences.workaround: Use is_close(precision=...) instead of eq() for float comparisons

divergences.summary: cbrt() of a negative value returns NaN on every backend (the pow(x, 1/3) implementation is undefined for negatives), instead of the real cube root
divergences.impact: ma.col(x).cbrt() on negative inputs yields NaN across all backends; a mathematically-correct negative cube root is not available
divergences.workaround: Compute sign(x) * abs(x) ** (1/3) manually for negative inputs

divergences.summary: pivot (long-to-wide) is unsupported on ibis (TypeError) and narwhals-lazy (AttributeError)
divergences.impact: Relation.pivot() raises on all ibis backends and narwhals-lazy; polars and eager narwhals compute it
divergences.workaround: Use a polars or eager narwhals backend for pivot

divergences.summary: horizontal greatest()/least() produce diverging values on pandas and narwhals-pandas (pandas element-wise max/min semantics differ from polars/ibis)
divergences.impact: Relation greatest()/least() diverge on pandas/narwhals-pandas; polars/narwhals-polars and ibis agree
divergences.workaround: Use a polars or ibis backend for horizontal greatest/least

divergences.summary: str.contains with a columnar (per-row) literal pattern is unsupported on pandas (enriched BackendCapabilityError, not registry-resolvable) and ibis-polars (UnsupportedArgumentError)
divergences.impact: col.str.contains(other_col) raises on pandas and ibis-polars; polars and ibis-duckdb/ibis-sqlite compute the per-row substring test
divergences.workaround: Use a polars or ibis SQL backend for columnar substring patterns

divergences.summary: str.center(width, char) is unsupported on pandas/narwhals (enriched BackendCapabilityError — padding option not honorable) and ibis-polars (UnsupportedArgumentError — columnar length argument)
divergences.impact: ma.col(x).str.center(...) raises on pandas, all narwhals backends, and ibis-polars; polars and ibis-duckdb/ibis-sqlite compute it
divergences.workaround: Use a polars or ibis SQL backend for str.center()

divergences.summary: regexp_string_split on an empty or zero-width-capable regex pattern diverges from the ibis-duckdb oracle — Polars has no native regex-split primitive, so mountainash falls back to a Python re.finditer-based split, which consolidates zero-width matches differently than DuckDB's regex engine
divergences.impact: regexp_string_split('') or a zero-width-capable pattern like 'a*' returns extra leading/trailing empty-string elements on polars that ibis-duckdb's native re_split does not produce; ordinary (non-degenerate) patterns are unaffected
divergences.workaround: Use an ibis-duckdb backend for regexp_string_split with an empty or zero-width-capable pattern

divergences.summary: a ternary comparison with a fill_null operand and booleanizer=None raises on polars/polars-lazy (SchemaError: expected Boolean got i64) and pandas/narwhals-pandas (TypeError: Boolean array expected)
divergences.impact: t_gt(col.fill_null(0)) with booleanizer=None raises on polars/polars-lazy and pandas/narwhals-pandas; narwhals-polars/narwhals-lazy and ibis compute it
divergences.workaround: Pass an explicit booleanizer, or use narwhals-polars/ibis backends

divergences.summary: All-NULL casts to non-nullable numpy int64/bool raise or corrupt nulls
divergences.impact: Pandas-backed integer casts raise and boolean casts can map None to False
divergences.workaround: Use polars, narwhals-polars, narwhals-lazy, or an Ibis backend

divergences.summary: pandas/narwhals-pandas have no nullable boolean dtype for comparison results, so a null rule result collapses to False instead of the 'unknown' outcome (mountainash targets plain float64/bool on pandas)
divergences.impact: validation outcome-model tests expecting an 'unknown' verdict from a null comparison diverge on pandas/narwhals-pandas
divergences.workaround: Use a polars, narwhals-polars, or ibis backend for three-way null outcome semantics

divergences.summary: ibis-polars/ibis-sqlite infer an untyped NullColumn for an all-null input, so a scalar-aggregate verdict over it diverges from the polars/narwhals result
divergences.impact: a ScalarRule verdict over an all-null column diverges on ibis-polars/ibis-sqlite; polars/narwhals compute the 'unknown' verdict (ibis-duckdb rejects the all-null table outright — IB-REL-06)
divergences.workaround: Use a polars or narwhals backend for scalar verdicts over all-null columns

divergences.summary: rank(method='dense'|'ordinal') is only supported on polars; every other backend raises TypeError
divergences.impact: col().rank(method='dense'|'ordinal') raises TypeError on ibis/narwhals/pandas; only polars/polars-lazy support the method= param for dense/ordinal
divergences.workaround: Use dense_rank()/row_number() directly, or a polars backend

divergences.summary: ntile() is unsupported off polars (ibis SignatureValidationError; narwhals/pandas NotImplementedError)
divergences.impact: col().ntile(n).over() raises on ibis and narwhals/pandas backends; only polars/polars-lazy compute it
divergences.workaround: Use a polars backend for ntile()

divergences.summary: Applying .over() to a non-window (elementwise/scalar) expression is rejected off polars (ibis IbisTypeError; narwhals/pandas InvalidOperationError)
divergences.impact: scalar_expr.over(...) raises on ibis and narwhals/pandas; polars evaluates the windowed scalar
divergences.workaround: Use a polars backend, or wrap a genuine window function

divergences.summary: narwhals-lazy rejects mode()/any_value(): order-dependent/length-changing aggregates are not permitted on a LazyFrame (InvalidOperationError)
divergences.impact: mode() and any_value() raise on narwhals-lazy; eager narwhals and other backends compute them
divergences.workaround: Use an eager backend for mode()/any_value()

divergences.summary: pandas and narwhals have no cast failure-behavior parameter; cast(failure_behavior=NULL) (try-cast) raises BackendCapabilityError instead of nulling invalid values
divergences.impact: ma.col(x).cast(dtype, failure_behavior=NULL) raises on pandas and all narwhals backends; polars and ibis-polars/ibis-duckdb null the invalid rows
divergences.workaround: Use a polars or ibis-polars/ibis-duckdb backend for null-on-cast-failure semantics

divergences.summary: Narwhals does not support dt.time() — NotImplementedError on all narwhals backends
divergences.impact: dt.time() raises on narwhals-polars/narwhals-pandas/narwhals-lazy; polars and ibis-duckdb/ibis-polars compute it
divergences.workaround: Use a polars or ibis backend for dt.time()

divergences.summary: the default pandas backend and narwhals-pandas do not implement dt.date() extraction; the op raises NotImplementedError (narwhals-polars computes it)
divergences.impact: ma.col(x).dt.date() raises on pandas and narwhals-pandas; polars, narwhals-polars, and ibis compute it
divergences.workaround: Use a polars/narwhals-polars or ibis backend for dt.date()

divergences.summary: pandas and narwhals do not implement dt.time()/month_start()/month_end()/days_in_month(); these ops raise NotImplementedError
divergences.impact: ma.col(x).dt.time()/month_start()/month_end()/days_in_month() raise on pandas and all narwhals backends; polars and ibis compute them
divergences.workaround: Use a polars or ibis backend for these datetime enrichment ops

divergences.summary: pandas and narwhals lack ISO week_of_year; the mountainash expression system raises BackendCapabilityError (unenriched)
divergences.impact: dt.week_of_year() raises on pandas and all narwhals backends; polars and ibis compute it
divergences.workaround: Use a polars or ibis backend for ISO week extraction

divergences.summary: narwhals-pandas dt.date() raises NotImplementedError
divergences.impact: dt.date() raises on narwhals-pandas; narwhals-polars, polars and ibis compute it
divergences.workaround: Use narwhals-polars, polars, or an ibis backend for dt.date()

divergences.summary: Narwhals lacks native list operations; the mountainash narwhals expression system raises BackendCapabilityError (unenriched) for these list ops
divergences.impact: list.gather_every/arg_min/arg_max/all/any/n_unique/count_matches/drop_nulls/set_union/set_intersection/set_difference/std/var/shift/diff/concat/join/reverse/slice/head/tail/explode raise on narwhals backends
divergences.workaround: Use a Polars or Ibis backend for these list operations

divergences.summary: pandas and narwhals lack tan(), so cot() (computed as 1/tan) raises NotImplementedError
divergences.impact: ma.col(x).cot() raises on pandas and all narwhals backends; polars and ibis compute it
divergences.workaround: Use a polars or ibis backend for cot()

divergences.summary: pandas and narwhals lack native trigonometric, angular-conversion, and hyperbolic math functions; these ops raise NotImplementedError
divergences.impact: trig (sin/cos/tan/asin/acos/atan/atan2), angular (radians/degrees), and hyperbolic (sinh/cosh/tanh/asinh/acosh/atanh) raise on pandas and all narwhals backends; polars and ibis (polars/duckdb) compute them
divergences.workaround: Use a polars or ibis-polars/ibis-duckdb backend for these math functions

divergences.summary: narwhals-lazy with_row_index() requires an explicit order_by= (row order over a LazyFrame is undefined); calling it without one raises TypeError
divergences.impact: Relation.with_row_index() raises on narwhals-lazy; eager narwhals/polars and ibis-duckdb/ibis-sqlite assign a 0..N-1 index
divergences.workaround: Use an eager backend, or pass an explicit order before the lazy row index

divergences.summary: Narwhals does not support unnest of a struct column
divergences.impact: Relation.unnest() raises on narwhals backends; polars and ibis compute it
divergences.workaround: Use a polars or ibis backend for unnest

divergences.summary: narwhals join_asof(tolerance=...) is GATE-UNSUPPORTED family-wide (capabilities/narwhals.py); a raw pandas.DataFrame is routed through the same narwhals identity at runtime
divergences.impact: Relation.join_asof(tolerance=...) raises BackendCapabilityError on all narwhals-family dialects, including the 'pandas' test backend
divergences.workaround: Drop tolerance= or use the polars/ibis backends

divergences.summary: pandas merge_asof raises ValueError on null as-of keys (left or right side); narwhals-polars/narwhals-lazy compute no-match rows like Polars
divergences.impact: Relation.join_asof() with null keys raises on narwhals-pandas and the 'pandas' test backend; polars/narwhals-polars/narwhals-lazy/ibis compute no-match rows
divergences.workaround: Use a polars, narwhals-polars, narwhals-lazy, or ibis backend for asof joins over null keys

divergences.summary: narwhals-pandas nearest may pick a different duplicate right row than Polars on a duplicate-right-key tie (Polars keeps the last of a tied group; the portable forward-wins fix inherits pandas merge_asof's own first-of-duplicates convention within each of its two internal legs) — the genuine cross-side tie (forward candidate vs a DIFFERENT-valued backward candidate) is unaffected and matches Polars
divergences.impact: Relation.join_asof(strategy='nearest') on narwhals-pandas/'pandas' may select a different (but still equally-near) right row than Polars when the right frame has duplicate keys at the winning distance
divergences.workaround: Use polars, narwhals-polars, narwhals-lazy, or an ibis backend for exact duplicate-tie parity under nearest

divergences.summary: narwhals-pandas title/initcap route to pandas str.title(); its Unicode titlecasing of sharp-S/ligatures differs from polars to_titlecase (e.g. 'ße' -> 'ẞe' vs 'SSe')
divergences.impact: title()/initcap() on narwhals-pandas may differ from polars/narwhals-polars on non-ASCII inputs (sharp-S, ligatures); ASCII is identical
divergences.workaround: Use polars or narwhals-polars where exact polars titlecasing of non-ASCII is required

divergences.summary: pandas and narwhals lack directional trimming: ltrim/rtrim and strip_chars_start/end strip BOTH sides (only strip_chars is native), so leading/trailing-only requests over-strip
divergences.impact: ltrim/rtrim and str.strip_chars_start()/strip_chars_end() strip both sides on pandas/narwhals; polars and ibis strip only the requested side
divergences.workaround: Use a polars or ibis backend for directional trimming

divergences.summary: str.repeat(n) is unsupported on pandas and narwhals (BackendCapabilityError); no repeat translation is wired for these backends
divergences.impact: ma.col(x).str.repeat(n) raises on pandas and all narwhals backends; polars and ibis compute it
divergences.workaround: Use a polars or ibis backend for str.repeat()

divergences.summary: str.replace_slice(start, length, replacement) is a silent no-op on pandas and narwhals: the slice arguments never reach the backend so the string is returned unchanged instead of having the slice replaced
divergences.impact: ma.col(x).str.replace_slice(...) returns the input unchanged on pandas and all narwhals backends; polars and ibis replace the intended slice
divergences.workaround: Use a polars or ibis backend for str.replace_slice()

divergences.summary: contains()/starts_with()/ends_with() on a null INPUT row (not a null search operand) returns False on pandas/narwhals-pandas instead of propagating null: plain-numpy-backed pandas boolean columns have no null representation, and forcing one via nw.when/then/otherwise produces an object-dtype column of Python bool objects, which breaks `~` elsewhere (bitwise-NOT on bool is not logical negation)
divergences.impact: a null row in the searched column silently yields False rather than null on pandas/narwhals-pandas for contains/starts_with/ends_with; every other backend (polars, ibis, narwhals-polars, narwhals-lazy) propagates null correctly
divergences.workaround: Use a polars, narwhals-polars, narwhals-lazy, or ibis backend where a null row must propagate through contains/starts_with/ends_with

divergences.summary: narwhals-lazy rejects order-dependent window expressions (diff/cumulative/lead/lag/shift/first_value/last_value) on a LazyFrame (InvalidOperationError)
divergences.impact: order-dependent window ops (diff/cum_*/lead/lag/shift/first_value/last_value) raise on narwhals-lazy; eager narwhals and polars compute them
divergences.workaround: Use an eager backend, or establish an explicit order before the lazy diff

divergences.summary: narwhals backends raise NotImplementedError for percent_rank()/cume_dist()/nth_value() and diff(n>1)
divergences.impact: percent_rank/cume_dist/nth_value and multi-step diff raise on narwhals/pandas; ibis-duckdb/sqlite compute them (polars too, except nth_value — see PL-WIN-01)
divergences.workaround: Use a polars or ibis SQL backend for these window ops

divergences.summary: Polars expression-level list.explode() in a multi-column select raises ShapeError: the exploded column's row count diverges from un-exploded siblings
divergences.impact: col('arr').list.explode() projected alongside a non-exploded sibling column raises polars.exceptions.ShapeError on eager and lazy Polars
divergences.workaround: Explode without a mismatched sibling column, or use an Ibis backend

divergences.summary: polars nth_value().over() raises ShapeError: the window expression length does not match the group
divergences.impact: col().nth_value(n).over() raises on eager and lazy Polars; only ibis-duckdb/ibis-sqlite compute nth_value
divergences.workaround: Use an ibis-duckdb/ibis-sqlite backend for nth_value()
